task: Multi-window synced players (max 3) with admin-only PlaybackCtrl
constraints: Server-side authz on PLAYER_REQ_* is OUT of scope (accepted risk, do not add)
Mirrors mute via AudioContext GainNode gain=0, never element.muted (CDG lyrics clock off audio.currentTime)
playbackRate nudging is the steady-state drift mechanism; seeking only for initial alignment and >1s recovery
Single-player behavior must be unchanged when only one window is open

stories.title: Action types and server-side player registry with role assignment
acceptanceCriteria: shared/actionTypes.ts exports PLAYER_EMIT_JOIN ('server/PLAYER_EMIT_JOIN'), PLAYER_ROLE ('player/ROLE'), PLAYER_REJECTED ('player/REJECTED')
Rooms.getPlayers(io, roomId) returns sockets having a truthy _playerRole, sorted ascending by _playerJoinedAt
Rooms.isPlayerPresent is re-expressed in terms of getPlayers().length > 0 (role-based, not _lastPlayerStatus-based) and all existing call sites still compile
PLAYER_EMIT_JOIN handler assigns _playerRole='primary' when the room has 0 players, 'mirror' when it has 1 or 2, and stamps _playerJoinedAt
PLAYER_EMIT_JOIN handler with 3 existing players sets no role and emits PLAYER_REJECTED to that socket only
PLAYER_ROLE is emitted only to the joining socket (io.to(sock.id)), never broadcast to the room

stories.title: Slot release and primary promotion on leave and disconnect
acceptanceCriteria: A single releasePlayer(io, sock) helper is exported from server/Player/socket.ts and used by BOTH the PLAYER_EMIT_LEAVE handler and the disconnect handler in server/socket.ts (no duplicated promotion logic)
releasePlayer clears _playerRole and _lastPlayerStatus on the leaving socket
When the leaving socket was primary and mirrors remain, the oldest surviving mirror (lowest _playerJoinedAt) is set to 'primary' and receives PLAYER_ROLE
When the leaving socket was a mirror, no promotion occurs and remaining roles are unchanged
PLAYER_LEAVE is broadcast to the room only when zero players remain
A socket disconnect without a clean PLAYER_EMIT_LEAVE frees the slot (registry is keyed on live sockets)

stories.title: Late-joining clients receive the primary's status
acceptanceCriteria: server/socket.ts join path emits the primary player's _lastPlayerStatus rather than the first socket found with a status
The '@todo this just emits the first status found' comment is removed
When no player is present, no PLAYER_STATUS is emitted on join (unchanged behavior)

stories.title: Client player slice gains role, leader position, and primary-only emit
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerState includes role: 'primary' | 'mirror' | 'rejected' | null and the underscore-prefixed _leaderPosition and _leaderPositionAt
playerStatus thunk includes positionAt: Date.now() in the emitted payload
playerStatus thunk emits nothing when role !== 'primary' (mirrors never emit status)
Reducer has a PLAYER_ROLE case setting state.role
Reducer has a PLAYER_REJECTED case setting role='rejected'

Reducer has a PLAYER_STATUS case that applies ONLY when role === 'mirror', adopting queueId, mediaType, isPlaying, isVideoKeyingEnabled, volume-independent fields, and recording _leaderPosition/_leaderPositionAt
The PLAYER_STATUS case is a no-op when role === 'primary' (a primary must never adopt its own echoed status)
_leaderPosition and _leaderPositionAt are stripped from emitted status by the existing underscore filter

stories.title: PlayerController joins on mount and mirrors relinquish queue authority
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerController dispatches PLAYER_EMIT_JOIN once on mount
handleLoadNext, handleReplay, and the nextUserId lock-in effect are gated to role === 'primary'
The always-emit status effect is gated to role === 'primary'
A mirror still resolves queueItem from the adopted queueId so Player receives the same props as today
With exactly one player window open, behavior is byte-for-byte the same as before this change (primary path untouched)

stories.title: Media sync: muted mirrors, alignment seek, playbackRate nudging
acceptanceCriteria: A pure function in src/lib/mediaSync.ts computes target position from (leaderPosition, leaderPositionAt, now, isPlaying) and returns the correction to apply
Correction returns playbackRate 1 when |drift| < 0.02s (dead zone)
Correction returns a playbackRate clamped to [0.98, 1.02] for drift within the nudging band
Correction returns a hard-seek instruction when |drift| > 1.0s
src/lib/mediaSync.test.ts covers the dead zone, both clamp bounds, the sign of the correction, and the hard-seek threshold, and passes under `npm test`
All sync wiring lives in Player.tsx (which already receives the media element via onAudioElement); MP4Player.tsx, MP4AlphaPlayer.tsx, and CDGPlayer.tsx are NOT modified
Mirrors set the AudioContext GainNode gain to 0; element.muted is never used
On media change a mirror performs a one-time alignment seek to the projected leader position before steady-state nudging begins
Mirrors do not forward onStatus and do not call onEnd (no queue advance from a mirror)

stories.title: Rejected 4th window shows the queue
acceptanceCriteria: When role === 'rejected', PlayerView renders <Navigate to='/queue' replace /> instead of PlayerController
A 'player limit reached' message is surfaced through the existing showErrorMessage ui action
The rejected window holds no player slot server-side (no _playerRole was assigned)

stories.title: PlaybackCtrl is admin-only
acceptanceCriteria: Header.tsx renders PlaybackCtrl only when isAdmin (the isUpNow disjunct is removed)
A non-admin whose turn it is no longer sees playback controls
No change is made to server/Player/socket.ts authorization (explicitly out of scope)
